summary: Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 (a blank-check SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing that its units (each consisting of one Class A ordinary share, one right, and one redeemable warrant) will begin separate trading of the components on Nasdaq on or about May 15, 2026. The shares, rights, and warrants will trade under MYX, MYXXR, and MYXXW, respectively. Only whole rights will trade; units not separated will continue under MYXXU. No deal terms, financial details, or business combination are announced. This is a routine post-IPO administrative step, not a special situation. What to watch: any future announcement of a target business combination.
